channel_findings.constants: Real storm footage as the full frame (18 of 19, thumb 4 is a two-photo split and 8 looks upscaled). Heavy geometric sans (Montserrat-class) with a dark drop shadow. Red #E3212B keyword with white or light grey lead-in (14 of 19 use red). Dark, desaturated grade (most frames near-black or dark slate/olive). No host face, no cutout, no badge, no border, no logo in any thumbnail.
channel_findings.host_treatment: 0 of 19 thumbnails show a channel host. One thumbnail (15, 9.4M views) shows an unidentified other person: head turned down, lower right, about 4 percent of frame width, waist-up crop, part of the scene, no outline or glow. Thumb 12 shows only a hand on the steering wheel. Face share: 1 of 19 for any person, 0 of 19 for a presenter. Lighting, cutout and placement rules for a host cannot be derived from this channel.
channel_findings.text_rules: Usually 2 to 4 words (17 of 19 have text; 2 have none). Title case or mixed case; the only all-caps word is EF5 (thumb 8); one lower-case quote (thumb 5). Placement: top centre for the year template (9 thumbs), left middle for the hook template (5 thumbs). Colours: white or light grey for lead-in or year, red for the key noun or verdict word. Highlight is the place or event name in red (year-title template) or the verdict word in red (hook template). Black text with no shadow appears only on the two lowest-view popular thumbs (7, 9). Biggest line is about 10 to 13 percent of frame height.
channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: Popular (n 1 to 9, views 0.46M to 4.7M): 5 of 9 use the left stacked two-word hook (1, 3, 6, 7, 9), 1 uses year-over-title (2), and 1 each uses split panel (4), top quote (5) and red callout (8). Latest (n 10 to 19, views 1.1M to 16.0M): 8 of 10 use year over red place-name (10, 11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19), 2 have no text (12, 15). Latest thumbs carry the 3 highest-view items. Data caution: meta.json labels 15 (9.4M) and 19 (16.0M) as latest, while the popular set tops out at 4.7M, so the popular label does not match views in this file. Compare the templates, not the labels.
channel_findings.top3: 19 (El Reno, 16.0M): real footage, huge wall cloud over a flat plain, year and place in the year-over-red template, no face. 15 (9.4M): no text, real on-scene funnel above wreckage, one unidentified person in lower right, no face of the channel. 18 (Bridge Creek, 7.6M): year and place in the year-over-red template over a bright white funnel. Shared: real storm footage as the whole frame, a single dominant tornado as subject, dark grade, no cutout, no host, and 2 of 3 use the year-over-place template.
transfer: Rule 1: Put the year in white on the top line and the place or event name in red below, centred, 2 to 3 words, title case. Evidence: 9 of 19 thumbs use it, including 19 (16.0M), 18 (7.6M) and 13 (2.4M).

Rule 2: Use real storm footage as the whole frame, dark and desaturated, with no cutout, badge or border. Evidence: 18 of 19 are real footage, 0 of 19 use a cutout, and the top 3 by views (19, 15, 18) are all real footage.

Rule 3: Test a face-free version first. 0 of 19 show a host, and the top 3 by views carry no presenter face. If the presenter appears, place him inside the scene like the unidentified man in 15 (9.4M), not as a cutout with an outline.
Rule 4: For a claim with no year, use a two-word left stack with one red word: 'No Warning.' (3), '0% Survival' (1), 'Nothing Left.' (6). Evidence: 3.6M, 4.7M and 1.5M views, all in the popular set.

Rule 5: Put one red keyword on a dark frame with a dark drop shadow, and leave black-only text off. Evidence: 14 of 19 use red; the two black-only thumbs (7 at 0.81M, 9 at 0.46M) are the lowest-view items on the channel.
weak: Thumb 9 (0.46M, lowest view count): black 'What Happened?' on a pale blue sky with no shadow or box, a soft low-resolution frame, and no clear subject besides a small orange glow.
Thumb 7 (0.81M): black '0.01% Chance' on a pale grey sky with no outline, a soft low-resolution frame, and two funnels that are small and low in the frame.
Thumb 8 (0.79M): a red 'EF5' with an arrow over an upscaled-looking city frame; the funnel the arrow points to is partly hidden in dark haze at the top right, and the skyline competes with it.
